title: Agent-router composition root dispatches with nil Deps.TokenResolver — token telemetry silently unmeasured on router-dispatched phases
summary: Every lane in batch-20260815c (and 6 hits in 20260815b, 3 in wave-5) logs the WARN pair: 'token usage uncovered for driver agy-tmux — no transcript/events/scrollback data (agent router)' followed by 'Deps.TokenResolver is nil — token telemetry disabled (fail-open); wire tokenusage.DefaultResolver at the composition root'. The production engine root DOES wire it (go/internal/adapters/bridge/bridge.go:148 — tokenusage.DefaultResolver(configRoot(env))), so the nil comes from a SECOND composition root: the agent-router dispatch path constructs bridge Deps without TokenResolver.
root_cause: Second-composition-root wiring gap — the same class as PR #459's finalize-defer emission fix (component wired at one root, absent at the sibling root). Router-dispatched phase work is recorded as 'unmeasured' (honest fail-open, not zero-cost), but this blinds the token-usage goal's telemetry on exactly the phases the standing goal wants to optimize.
fix: TWO confirmed sub-defects (batch-20260815c log lines 61-83): (1) agent-router root dispatches with nil TokenResolver — the WARN pair fires on every router dispatch; wire tokenusage.DefaultResolver via the same configRoot(env) recipe as bridge.go:148, plus a coherence test enumerating ALL Deps composition roots asserting TokenResolver non-nil (class-kill: fails when a third root appears unwired). (2) Driver-source gap, PROVEN distinct: '(agent scout)' codex-tmux emits 'token usage uncovered' WITHOUT the nil-resolver WARN (log line 83) — resolver wired, but codex-tmux has no transcript/events/scrollback usage adapter; agy-tmux same. Since codex now carries scout/tester/build-planner/orchestrator (roster #461), unmeasured codex usage blinds the token goal on 4 phase families — add a codex usage source (session jsonl or scrollback parse) and an agy one if feasible.
files: go/internal/bridge/ (engine WARN emit sites; router Deps construction)
acceptance: Batch log shows ZERO 'Deps.TokenResolver is nil' WARNs across a full wave.
Router-dispatched phases report measured token usage (not 'unmeasured') for claude/codex drivers.
Coherence/wiring test red-first: fails on current tree (nil at router root), green after wiring; covers every Deps composition root by enumeration not hardcoded list where feasible.
go vet ./... green; touched-package tests + -race green.
connects_to: token_telemetry_campaign S1-S7 (this is a missed root, not a new subsystem)
standing goal: per-agent token usage optimization (unmeasured phases are invisible to it)
notes: Filed mid-batch 20260815c from console monitoring; preexisting class (present in 20260815b + wave5 logs), NOT a regression from v22.18.0. Fail-open is honest so not batch-blocking; weight below the 0.85+ pipeline-integrity band by design.
